product_metadata.title: Tasse Verre White Clock for Shelf Table Or Desk 9"x7" - Farmhouse Decor Wood Mechanical Quiet Silent - Office, Bedroom Fireplace Mantel Living Family Room. AA Battery Operated Non-Digital
features: ✅ THE PERFECT CLOCK FOR ANY ROOM: Your phone might be the first place you look to check the time, but adding a silent and quiet clock like this to a desk or table is a great option for not only keeping an eye on the hour, but also lending your home a decorative touch with country character.

✅ ADD A TOUCH OF CLASS TO YOUR HOME OR OFFICE: This beautiful, silent shelf clock features a clock face with black roman numerals and is perfect for any home decor style. This unique clock measures 9 inches x 7 inches and is the perfect size for any kitchen, living room, office, or bedroom. The front door on the clock does not have glass so there is no annoying glare.

✅ A GREAT GIFT FOR THE PERSON THAT HAS EVERYTHING: A quiet white shelf clock is the perfect gift for Christmas, birthdays, housewarmings, weddings, anniversary, Mother's Day, or any other special occasion.
✅ ALWAYS BE ON TIME: This white shelf/table/desk precision clock is battery operated and requires a single AA battery (not included).
